steps.content:
Across the WhiteSands, lies a behemoth on a desert oasis—Fraser City.
A city controlled by the Campbell family.
The current master of Fraser City, the fifth head of the Campbells, is the most ruthless leader in the family's history.

He managed to control 98% of WhiteSands' trade routes and major trade channels with the DisCity in just eight years.
This shows that they've never given up the idea of taking back the DisCity.
You turn off the monitor and pick up the files the 9th Agency prepared for you. Now you're ready to meet that Sinner arrested a few days ago. She was reported to be colluding with Outland.
<color=#e45515>"Do whatever it takes to confirm and uncover her backers." </color> The 9th Agency asked this of you while giving you the files.
Hello, may our cooperation go smoothly today.
As soon as you enter the interrogation room, you see a young woman sitting in a chair, smiling and greeting you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Likewise, Miss Eirene. I feel the same.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Of course, I will tell you everything.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I wouldn't want to leave a bad impression on the Chief.
Oh, and I thought I'd already shown enough sincerity...
With not even a greeting... It doesn't look like things will go well.
Still, I do wish to leave you with a good impression, Chief.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: As long as you're cooperative, Eirene.
Looking at the woman sitting on the interrogation chair, you're not really confident that you will be able to deal with this business magnate.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I have a rough idea as to what kind of people you catch.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: As you can see, I am a Sinner.
Eirene looks at the thin white sheet of paper in your hand and directly admits it.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: But apart from this, I don't think I've done anything against the law, right?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: The tax revenue Quinn brings to the DisCity every year is over one billion, and that's not enough to grant me bail?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I don't mind if you want to put me under comprehensive surveillance, it's just that... If I'm not there, Quinn's stock price is going to plummet.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I'm afraid it'll bring unnecessary troubles, among many other things...
As if distressed, Eirene gives a leisurely sigh.

options: I don't need to know that.

choices.text: I don't need to know that.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's not my role to find out what a giant financial group president can affect.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Alright then. In that case, let's talk about something else. As long as you're interested, you can ask... anything about me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Thank you for your consent. Then let's talk about some... legends about you.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Eastside has a lot of talents. Didn't think I would have my own legends too.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Perhaps the people spreading them might just be overestimating me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: There's no need to be modest. To be able to build Quinn from an obscure small business to a financial investment conglomerate... That's no small feat.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: It's not just me, but the result of everyone's efforts.
Eirene laughs softly, and the words that come out of her mouth are all entrepreneurs' cliché.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Well, there must always be a leader who can act as the brains and devise successful strategies.
Eirene raises an eyebrow.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: ...I'm flattered.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: As part of our rules, an elite who is detected to be a Sinner would not be immediately arrested... Unless... they've touched something they shouldn't have.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Something they shouldn't have?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Quinn has businesses in every aspect of the DisCity... So, I'm actually curious, is there something I cannot touch?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Ah... There certainly is. You're right in front of me, but I have no way of touching you. What a pity.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm actually giving you a piece of advice, Miss Eirene.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: But leaving out my identity as a Sinner, I'm just a law-abiding businesswoman.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The first reason for your arrest is your identity as a Sinner. As for the second reason...
test
test
test
test
test
test
The moment the recorder is put on the table, Eirene frowns slightly.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: In business, it's all about credentials and trust. It seems like some of my business partners do not have enough trust in me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's normal. It's just like how you're friendly to me but do not trust me.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: That's right, I like your straightforwardness.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: In that case, you'll have to explain to me the content of this recording.
You press the button on the recorder, skipping over some irrelevant parts and stopping at specific keywords.

steps.speaker: Recording
steps.content: "Even that Councilor Enoch recognized your achievements, so we all think highly of you and believe you're qualified to join or participate in the Nirvana business."

steps.speaker: Recording
steps.content: "Hey, Nirvana has been monopolizing <color=#e45515>Hypercube transport</color> for a long time. It's about time for some new blood."

steps.speaker: Recording
steps.content: "Thank you, <color=#e45515>Councilors</color>, for thinking so highly of me. Given that I'm qualified, I'm more than happy to take on the responsibilities and risks."
Eirene's speech in the recording is flawless, as if the interests in question have nothing to do with her at all.
You have to admit that Eirene has excellent negotiation skills, holding back any sentence that may pose a risk to herself.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Tell me about these councilors.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Quinn is an essential part of Eastside's daily operations. I'm thankful for the councilors' trust, granting me a chance to talk with them from time to time.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I don't know who turned in this recording, but... there's something I have to clarify.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: That was just banter, don't take it seriously. I'm not so stupid as to get involved with Hypercubes and expose my identity as a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You don't think I would adopt such a foolish proposal, do you, Chief? Haha, perhaps... I'd overestimated you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The Hypercube is an important resource that the world depends on and should never fall into the hands of individuals.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I know that, Your Excellency. But you have to understand... I am first and foremost a businesswoman.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Within the bounds of ethics and the law, an entrepreneur must seek to maximize their business value and profits.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Industries related to Hypercubes are what bring in the money. Seeing that Quinn cannot break into the mining and processing sectors, naturally we're casting our gaze onto these <color=#e45515>LEGAL</color> related industries.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It is nigh impossible for private companies to obtain transportation or other rights to Hypercubes.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: However, it's just nigh impossible, haha...

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Ordinary people might be deterred by the high bar and find excuses for themselves. But actually... it's not that unattainable.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Those councilors were just optimistic about Quinn's stock and abilities, so they were testing the waters.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Indeed, but to my understanding... the Hypercube industry is mostly a high-polluting and industrialized sector.

options: The plants are mostly located in Syndicate.

choices.text: The plants are mostly located in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Right, Syndicate's former glory could be attributed to these industries.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even today, many still make a living in the mines in Syndicate, despite all the risks and dangers of those jobs.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: ...And how does that have anything to do with what we were discussing earlier?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A venture capital firm in Syndicate on the crest of a wave... It's providing many with the means to engage in Hypercube mining.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You reign in the financial world. Do you know anything about this?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: ...I've heard some rumors.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: They are acquiring ownership and mining rights from various gangsters in Syndicate... then luring people down to mine with high prices.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Mines are profitable, and where there is a market... there will be transactions.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Apparently you know more than you claimed. So tell me. Since you've decided to get involved in related industries such as transportation of Hypercubes...

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Are you trying to make me admit that there's something going on... between me and these mines and that venture company?
Eirene looks at you expressionlessly, but it only lasts for two seconds. She laughs gracefully and looks straight at you.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Indeed, we've had a few exchanges. But regretfully, not the kind of exchange you're imagining...

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Those who are willing to take up hard work in Syndicate are either shameless thugs or goons who are unhappy with their lives.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: But... I'm sorry, Chief. Quinn is not too keen on associating itself with those pests, so we didn't make any deals with them.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Moreover, I'm sure you know better than us that these allegations require evidence.
Eirene is eyeing you with amusement, as if waiting for your next move.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And you think the Bureau doesn't have evidence?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: What else could it be? I look forward to seeing if you can pull any proof out of thin air...

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Who knows, it might just help set me free.
You lean back onto the back of the seat, adjust your position, and start talking to Eirene.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Your face reminds me of someone.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: What?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Game Master
You fix your eyes on Eirene, observing her every move.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Miss Eirene, you're so impressive that you remind me of that rather famous family business leader, Bryce Campbell.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: ...That's quite the big gun. How could I possibly compare to him?
Eirene's fingers begin to move, patting away the non-existent dust on her coat.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You've asked many strange but pointless questions. Is this the MBCC's way of interrogation?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I can accept being put under your surveillance, but not to be arrested for no reason.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You make a good point, Miss Eirene... The MBCC would never arrest people for no reason.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You have to understand that the DisCity's trade channels with Outland have always been under strict control by the Outland Affairs Bureau.
Eirene remains silent, her face growing gloomy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm curious about something, Miss Eirene. You're an Eastsider.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Eastsiders have always disliked Syndicate, not to mention Outlanders. But you don't seem to share the sentiment...
test
test
test
test
test
test
test

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Around 80 percent of Bishop's employees are from Syndicate and... Outland.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why would you have exchanges with an enterprise in which over half of the staff are Outlanders? Even if the exchanges did fall through in the end, still I wonder why?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Silence won't do you any good, Miss Eirene.
Eirene props her hand on her jaw and takes a deep breath.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Like I've said, Quinn will never say no to any profitable business so long as the law and ethics allow it.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Of course, I am quite critical of Outland, but no entrepreneur would let their pathetic pride and ego get in the way of making a great profit.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Yet Quinn cherishes its reputation. Although there may have been exchanges, Quinn has never been involved in any trade with Outland.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Like I've said before, Chief. If you are to accuse me or Bishop... you'll need evidence, definitive evidence.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Regarding freight trade with Outland, the DisCity not only has special freight channels, but also special freight lists. The two sides of the trade are generally DisCity councilors and Outland political leaders.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: In the shipping manifests submitted by Quinn, we found this.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Miss Eirene, I'd like to know, why was this shipping manifest between the DisCity and Outland found in Quinn's shipping manifests?
You tap on a small piece of square paper on the table that is crammed with information.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I don't know.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The words "I do not know" are not a get-out-of-jail-free card, Miss Eirene.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: When it comes to this kind of freight deal involving the FAC, I suppose you won't delegate casually and let your subordinates take care of it for you, will you?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: If you're accusing the corporation of falsifying shipping manifests for no reason, can I ask to see my lawyer?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Of course, Miss Eirene.

options: But why would you think it's fake?

choices.text: But why would you think it's fake?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You don't seem surprised about Outland having its own special shipping manifests... Tell me, why would a corporate leader who insists they've never been involved in such things seem so unsurprised, and on top of that be able to tell the manifest is fake?
Eirene narrows her eyes and glances at you.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You tricked me?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Looks like we're the same kind of people... We would do unscrupulous things in order to achieve something...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I only dare to speak to you like this because... Councilor Enoch told us a couple of things when he found out we were investigating this.
Eirene shows a hint of panic but quickly returns to how she was before.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: That voice recorder was given to you by Enoch, right?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: That's right. Quinn does have some dealings with Outland, but they all... happen under the authorization of Councilor Enoch.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: If you can find the real shipping manifest, you'll see Enoch's stamp all over it.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: That does not indicate that I directly trade with Outland.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: The goods moving between Quinn and Outland have to be inspected by Enoch before they are released.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Why?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: When we requested to inspect the cargo, Councilor Enoch was so nervous that we had to bring up the name of the 9th Agency to continue with our inspection.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Sigh... I guess name-dropping the 9th Agency does work miracles.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Enoch probably gave you the recorder to safeguard those goods... I never thought I'd be the one sacrificed some day.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So let's be open about it, Miss Eirene.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Enoch has handed three shipping channels to Quinn, which correspond to three different Outland states.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: He didn't just want to transport Hypercubes; he wanted the DisCity to trade other industrial products with Outland as well.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: To support Outland, the DisCity usually asks them to trade the equivalent production materials or household goods.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But during this investigation, it's been found that the metals used for trading... seem to be unsatisfactory both in terms of weight and density.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Fraser City's precious metal salvaging operations have always been hazardous and luck-dependent. It's normal to have some margin of error.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Regretfully, Enoch's camouflage is not convincing enough.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: DisCoins of the same weight can be considered as a precious metal too in a sense. Am I right, Miss Eirene?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Besides the DisCoins, we found something else that's interesting.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: After Enoch handed over the freight channels to Quinn, Quinn suddenly raised its tax rate by 5% and actively took part in various charitable activities.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Meanwhile, in the Fraser City shipping manifest, the Campbell family's tax income on the goods was lowered by 5%.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That means that each month, Fraser City has 5% more money for various purposes, including the military...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Coincidentally, that year saw an abnormal trend in desert bandit activity in the unruled areas in WhiteSands. It heightened tension with the DisCity.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Do you still insist it's a mere coincidence, Miss Eirene?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Looks like you've done your homework.
Eirene sighs and leans back weakly.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Quite a lot actually, and it means we have a very high regard for your ability.
Hearing your praise, Eirene smiles coldly.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: My ability...?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Relying on myself and my so-called special ability alone, it's impossible to build a business empire like Quinn.
The interrogation room falls silent after Eirene said that. As the dust in the shimmering light is about to come to a standstill, she opens her mouth again.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Quinn has infiltrated many aspects of the DisCity, be it the economy, daily life, technology... and even defense.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: But all of this is thanks to the "help" of my father, Bryce Campbell.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Besides him, who else could possibly create a business empire in such a short period of time? Not even his own daughter will be able to do it.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: My father had me build a business empire in Eastside. He wants to turn Eastside into his own supply warehouse...

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: He asked me to tamper with the freight trade. He even told me who to bribe.
A bitter laugh that seems like a sigh comes from Eirene. She props herself up and leans back in her chair with a lonely look.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Perhaps you're not aware, but Enoch is the only person I bribed based on my own judgment without listening to my father, and he ended up being my downfall.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I was not unaware of the danger these things would bring to the city and myself.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: But... I had no other way. I couldn't come up with a better way.
Eirene averts her eyes and stares at a tile under her feet.
The strong woman at the peak of Eastside's business empire is currently showing signs of vulnerability.
She's like a canary that escaped the cage but couldn't break free from the chains on her feet, landing here helplessly.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: My father used every available means to ascend to the position of the current head of the family in only eight years.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: And amongst those means was his own family... I was able to survive, but probably only because I once had a close match with him in chess.
Even you have heard Bryce Campbell's name here and there. His methods are described in the intel at great length.
The master of a city with a fearsome reputation. But who would've thought he would be this vicious to his own daughter?

options: Why don't you try to break free from his control?

choices.text: Why don't you try to break free from his control?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Now that you're in Eastside, you should have plenty of opportunities to do so.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You think I haven't tried?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I tried, and I realized it's safest being a pawn.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: So what?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Even now that I've awakened as a Sinner, he does not show a shred of fear.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: He would only tell me that now I have the ability to open up Syndicate's market as well.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: In the hands of those gangs lie a significant number of resources.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: So what...

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Would you really use such a terrible power against your own father?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even though he threatened your life?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: In this father-daughter relationship, I'm the only one being soft-hearted.

Eirene's confession means that the largest business in Eastside and its related conglomerate capable of intervening in the Hypercube industry... are colluding with Outland. This is no trivial matter. You decide to suspend the interrogation and take some time to think.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Do you believe her words?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Then why did you...?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What I don't believe is her objective... Even if Bryce has such a long reach, having been in Outland for so long, it would be impossible for him to control Eastside completely without any flaws. But she said that everything was orchestrated per her father's instructions...
You look at the DNA test report at the bottom of the pile. It was intended to be your trump card against Eirene's lies, but now it seems a bit pointless.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: She's smart. I don't believe a Sinner of that caliber would get manipulated that easily. Even if it's her father.
You think for a bit before including the interrogation in the report and immediately sending it to the 9th Agency.
Your report clearly points out the danger of Bryce and the need to investigate since he can manipulate even a Sinner. There may be a hidden force comparable to Sinners backing him.

Moreover, you believe that since Eirene voluntarily disclosed the truth, she stands to defect. You apply for a permit for the Sinner to go outside, wishing to take Eirene back to Fraser City with you.
